title: Equipment, Vehicle and Interface Compatibility
objective: Define common compatibility predicates for clothing, armor, weapons, tools, implants, suits, seats, mounts, vehicles and other body/interface relationships so diverse species and body plans can explicitly accept, adapt or reject interfaces without species-name branching or size-only inference.
acceptance: compatibility is not inferred only from size
common interface handles diverse body plans
boundaries: MVPS-07 owns species/body-plan-facing compatibility predicates and compatibility-result semantics only.
MVPS-03 morphology and MVPS-06 natural-equipment structures are consumed by reference rather than rewritten.
Item Definition, Asset Instance, ownership, equipment assignment, vehicle, mount and installation workflows remain with their shared owners.
Mount-capable and rider/occupant relationships may expose compatibility predicates here, but mount runtime/control/progression mechanics remain with the mount/vehicle/entity owners.
Lineage inheritance remains MVPS-08; form/transformation behavior remains MVPS-09; progression remains MVPS-10.
MVPS-08+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: Establish causal RED for a common side-effect-free compatibility seam over morphology/body structure plus shared-owner interface requirements; prove size-only/species-name inference forbidden, incompatible/unresolved results carry explicit reasons, adapters are explicit, and equipment/vehicle/mount owners retain all mutations.
